description: This file defines a Drupal 7 user migration source plugin class, including methods for querying user data, preparing data rows, and defining source fields and IDs.

classes.name: User
classes.description: A Drupal 7 migration source plugin class for user entities, extending FieldableEntity, providing methods to query user data, process rows, and define source fields.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds and returns a database query selecting all users with uid > 0.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Defines and returns the list of source fields for the user entity, including profile fields if the profile module exists.

methods.name: prepareRow
methods.description: Prepares each data row by loading roles, unserializing data, handling translations, and fetching profile field values.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Returns the primary key definition for the user source, based on 'uid'.
